title: What makes water move faster?
question: When the same water travels the same distance, what changes the time?

intro.speaker: Ranger Wren
lines: The creek isn't the same speed everywhere. There's a runoff table by the station. Same channel, same distance. Change one thing at a time.

unfairHint: Two things changed. If the water moved faster, which change caused it?
repeatHint: One run was odd. Would you trust one run, or try it again?
enoughHint: You've got comparable runs. Look at the numbers before you decide what they mean.
constantsNote: Channel, distance, and the cup stay the same unless you change them.

nudge: Same channel. Same stretch. What are you actually changing?
afterFair: The times aren't identical. That's normal. What's the overall pattern?
